mapper.sql: WITH answer_stats AS ( SELECT q.id AS question_id, COUNT(aa.question_id) AS response_count, COUNT(aa.question_id) FILTER (WHERE aa.is_correct) AS correct_count, COUNT(aa.question_id) FILTER (WHERE NOT aa.is_correct) AS incorrect_count FROM questions q LEFT JOIN attempt_answers aa ON aa.question_id = q.id GROUP BY q.id ), wrong_option_counts AS ( SELECT aa.question_id, aa.selected_option_id, COUNT(*) AS selected_count FROM attempt_answers aa WHERE NOT aa.is_correct GROUP BY aa.question_id, aa.selected_option_id ), wrong_stats AS ( SELECT question_id, MAX(selected_count) AS max_wrong_option_count FROM wrong_option_counts GROUP BY question_id ), quality_rows AS ( SELECT q.id AS question_id, qs.challenge_date, qs.variant_code, p.title AS passage_title, p.topic, p.position AS passage_position, q.position AS question_position, q.content AS question_content, stats.response_count, stats.correct_count, stats.incorrect_count, CASE WHEN stats.response_count = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(stats.correct_count * 100.0 / stats.response_count, 1) END AS correct_rate, COALESCE(wrong.max_wrong_option_count, 0) AS max_wrong_option_count, CASE WHEN stats.response_count < 5 THEN 'DATA_INSUFFICIENT' WHEN stats.correct_count * 100.0 / NULLIF(stats.response_count, 0) < 30 OR stats.correct_count * 100.0 / NULLIF(stats.response_count, 0) > 90 OR (stats.incorrect_count >= 3 AND COALESCE(wrong.max_wrong_option_count, 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(stats.incorrect_count, 0) >= 70) THEN 'REVIEW_REQUIRED' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS quality_status FROM questions q JOIN passages p ON p.id = q.passage_id JOIN quiz_sets qs ON qs.id = p.quiz_set_id JOIN answer_stats stats ON stats.question_id = q.id LEFT JOIN wrong_stats wrong ON wrong.question_id = q.id WHERE qs.status = 'PUBLISHED' )
mapper.select: SELECT quality_status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM quality_rows GROUP BY quality_status
